_comment: Off Site Games tab: games that run on other websites, opened in a new tab. Retro Hub doesn't host, run or check them. Default list (checked 2026-11-16, extended 2026-11-17 from the CC0 AwesomeDecompGames list, github.com/SubmitGame/awesome-decomp-games): free / open-source games, officially free data, or ports that need your own copy of the game (they say your files stay on your device). Owners: to use your own list, copy this file to offsite-games.json in the hub's main folder and edit it there (it replaces this one and is kept by the updater). Each game: name, url (https only), category, optional note and optional "touch": true when it works on phones / tablets.

games.name: Call of Duty: Zombies (NZ: Portable)
games.note: Free open-source fan game by the NZ:P team.

games.name: Duke Nukem 3D (EDuke32)
games.note: Open-source engine. Plays the free shareware episode, or load your own game files.

games.name: Quake 3 Arena (Q3JS)
games.note: Open-source ioquake3 with id Software's free demo data. Online servers.

games.name: Open Sonic
games.note: Free, open-source fan game.

games.name: Ratchet & Clank (ReRAC)
games.note: Fan port. Needs your own North American PS2 disc, read once on your computer.

games.name: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (Clean Room)
games.note: Fan-made clean-room remake with generated assets. No ROM needed.

games.name: The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess (Dusklight)
games.note: Decompilation port. Needs your own disc image; it stays in your browser.

games.name: Zelda II: The Adventure of Link (z2rs)
games.note: Open-source port. Needs your own Zelda II (USA) ROM; it stays in your browser.

games.name: The Elder Scrolls II: Daggerfall
games.note: Open-source rebuild. Needs your own copy of Daggerfall (free on Steam / GOG); your files stay on your device.

games.name: Golden Sun (Recomp)
games.note: Recompilation. Bring your own game files.

games.name: Cro-Mag Rally
games.note: Pangea's racer, from its open-source update. About 165 MB to load.

games.name: Mario Kart 64 (Golden Balloon port)
games.note: Fan source port from the decompilation. Needs your own ROM (US or EU 1.1); it stays in your browser.

games.name: SimCity (MicropolisJS)
games.note: Open-source (GPL) version of the original SimCity.

games.name: Masters of Defense
games.note: Tower defense on itch.io.

games.name: Beneath a Steel Sky
games.note: Freeware since 2003, by its makers (Revolution). Runs in ScummVM.

games.name: Diablo (diabloweb)
games.note: Open-source port. Plays the free shareware version, or load DIABDAT.MPQ from your own copy (e.g. GOG).

games.name: Halo: Combat Evolved (Combat Lab)
games.note: Browser port. Needs an Xbox disc image (XISO) made from your own disc; processed in your browser.

games.name: Half-Life / Counter-Strike 1.6 (WebXash)
games.note: Open-source Xash3D in the browser. Needs your own game files (valve / cstrike folders, e.g. from Steam).

games.name: Quake (NetQuake.io)
games.note: Episode 1 (shareware) free; upload pak1.pak from your own copy for all 4 episodes, checked locally. Online servers.

games.name: Doom multiplayer (Silent Space Marine)
games.note: Cloudflare's open-source Chocolate Doom WebAssembly port with the shareware episode. Online deathmatch.
